purpose: Teach: 教頭/推し進め/確証/製本/スキャナ/試験場/防火/配色

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、学校の教頭先生とも連携されますね
lines.en: So the police coordinate with the school vice-principal as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Not a question — a recognition of something noticed. Steady pace, slight emphasis on the collaborative nature. Respectful but genuinely interested.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地域防犯を推し進める活動、頼もしいです
lines.en: It's reassuring to see the police pushing forward with community crime prevention activities like this.
lines.style: Warm approval in the voice. Leisurely pace, allowing the appreciation to land. Slight lift at the end — affirming rather than flattering. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、確証のあるまで逮捕は慎重ですね
lines.en: And they're careful about making arrests until they have solid evidence, I notice.
lines.style: Measured, respectful of the procedural care. No rush. A gentle nod of understanding for the thoroughness. Quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の製本処理もご対応ですね
lines.en: They even handle the binding and processing of statements themselves.
lines.style: Slightly surprised by the attention to detail. Even-paced, matter-of-fact delivery that carries subtle appreciation for the meticulous work. Small pause before the statement, as if cataloging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、証拠物のスキャナ取り込みもされますね
lines.en: And they're doing the scanning and filing of evidence too.
lines.style: Noting another layer of their work with gentle recognition. No strain in the voice — just a factual observation that carries quiet respect for the scope of their responsibility.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、運転免許の試験場でも防犯啓発されますね
lines.en: Even at the driver's license test centers, they're raising awareness about crime prevention.
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting dots. Slightly wondering tone — noticing how far-reaching their efforts are. Slower pace on 'test centers,' savoring the detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防火指導も担当されますね
lines.en: And they're responsible for fire safety guidance as well.
lines.style: Recognition of yet another responsibility. Even cadence, building a sense of how broad their remit is. Sincere, not overwhelming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、パトカーの配色を統一されましたね
lines.en: They've even standardized the colors of their patrol cars.
lines.style: A shift toward lighter appreciation — this is the human touch, the visible care. Warmer tone. Slight smile in the voice. More intimate, like sharing something personally noticed.
